# Listen along (WebSocket)

Listen along provides shared listening rooms: one host controls playback and the queue, and all listeners stay synchronized.

Each room is a Cloudflare Durable Object. After the WebSocket connects, the server sends a `RoomState` snapshot. Subsequent updates are incremental JSON messages.

All messages, in both directions, use this envelope:

```json
{ "type": "Play", "payload": null }
```

**Keepalive:** send `{ "type": "Ping" }` approximately every 30 seconds. The server replies with `{ "type": "Pong" }`. Connections idle for 3 minutes are closed.

**Permissions:** the host and co-hosts control playback and the queue. Other listeners can chat, and can add songs or use song commands when the room allows it. Messages the sender is not permitted to send are ignored.

WebSocket requests cannot be sent from this page. Example using the browser console:

```js
const ws = new WebSocket("wss://listen-along.neurokaraoke.com/ws?inviteCode=ABC123&guestId=" + crypto.randomUUID());
ws.onmessage = e => console.log(JSON.parse(e.data));
```

Messages are `application/json` unless noted.

Server `production`: `wss://listen-along.neurokaraoke.com` — Listen along worker.

## Channel `/ws` — A listen along room

Specify exactly one of:

- `action=create` to create a room (requires a token. Guests cannot host)
- `roomId` to join a room returned by `/rooms/public`
- `inviteCode` to join via an invite link

Identify the caller with `token` (the neurokaraoke.com `authToken`) or, for guests, `guestId` (any UUID). `displayName`, `avatarUrl`, `frameTheme` and `level` are shown in the listener list.

When creating a room, the following are also accepted: `roomName`, `isPublic` (default true), `allowListenerAddSongs`, `allowListenerSongCommands`, `allowDuplicateSongs`, `listenerAddSongCooldownSeconds` and `autoRemovePlayedSongs`.

Handshake: HTTP `GET` upgrade to WebSocket.

Connection query:

```ts
{
  action: string  // Possible values: `create`
  roomId: string
  inviteCode: string
  token: string  // Bearer token from neurokaraoke.com. Omit to connect as a guest.
  guestId: string  // Any UUID. Reuse the same value to keep a stable guest identity.
  displayName: string
  avatarUrl: string
  frameTheme: int
  level: int
  roomName: string
  isPublic: bool  // default: true
  allowListenerAddSongs: bool  // default: false
  allowListenerSongCommands: bool  // default: false
  allowDuplicateSongs: bool  // default: false
  listenerAddSongCooldownSeconds: int  // default: 0
  autoRemovePlayedSongs: bool
}
```

## Client → server (send)

### Keep the connection alive

Send a Ping approximately every 30 seconds.

#### `Ping` — Keepalive request.

```ts
{
  type: "Ping"
}
```

### Control playback

Restricted to the host and co-hosts. Each change is followed by a PlaybackSync broadcast.

#### `Play` — Resume playback.

```ts
{
  type: "Play"
}
```

#### `Pause` — Pause playback.

```ts
{
  type: "Pause"
}
```

#### `Seek` — Seek within the current song.

```ts
{
  type: "Seek"
  payload: number  // Position in seconds.
}
```

Example:

```json
{"type": "Seek", "payload": 42.5}
```

#### `SkipNext` — Advance to the next song in the queue.

```ts
{
  type: "SkipNext"
}
```

#### `SkipPrevious` — Restart the current song, or move to the previous song if playback is near the start.

```ts
{
  type: "SkipPrevious"
}
```

#### `PlaySongAt` — Start playback at a specific queue item.

```ts
{
  type: "PlaySongAt"
  payload: (string | {
    queueItemId: string
    songId: string
  })  // Queue item reference: a `queueItemId` (or `songId`) string, or an object containing either field.
}
```

#### `ReportPosition` — Host playback heartbeat, sent every few seconds to keep listeners synchronized.

```ts
{
  type: "ReportPosition"
  payload: {
    positionSeconds: number
    isPlaying: bool
  }
}
```

Example:

```json
{"type": "ReportPosition", "payload": {"positionSeconds": 61.2, "isPlaying": true}}
```

### Change the queue

Host and co-hosts can send all of these. Listeners can only send ListenerAddSong, and only when the room allows it.

#### `AddSong` — Appends a song to the queue. Ignored if the song is already queued, unless duplicates are allowed.

```ts
{
  type: "AddSong"
  payload: {
    queueItemId?: string
    songId: string
    title?: string
    artists?: string
    audioUrl?: string
    hlsUrl?: string
    coverUrl?: string
    duration?: number  // Duration in seconds.
    addedBy?: string
  }  // Queue item. `queueItemId` and `addedBy` are assigned by the server.
}
```

#### `RemoveSong` — Removes a song from the queue.

```ts
{
  type: "RemoveSong"
  payload: (string | {
    queueItemId: string
    songId: string
  })  // Queue item reference: a `queueItemId` (or `songId`) string, or an object containing either field.
}
```

#### `ReorderQueue` — Moves a queue item to a new position.

```ts
{
  type: "ReorderQueue"
  payload: {
    queueItemId?: string
    songId?: string
    newOrder: int  // Zero-based target index.
  }
}
```

Example:

```json
{"type": "ReorderQueue", "payload": {"queueItemId": "q_123", "newOrder": 0}}
```

#### `ShuffleQueue` — Shuffles the remaining queue items.

```ts
{
  type: "ShuffleQueue"
}
```

#### `SetRepeatMode` — Sets the repeat mode.

```ts
{
  type: "SetRepeatMode"
  payload: string  // Possible values: `Off`, `All`, `One`
}
```

#### `ListenerAddSong` — AddSong variant for listeners. Requires the room's listener-add permission and is subject to the room's cooldown.

```ts
{
  type: "ListenerAddSong"
  payload: {
    queueItemId?: string
    songId: string
    title?: string
    artists?: string
    audioUrl?: string
    hlsUrl?: string
    coverUrl?: string
    duration?: number  // Duration in seconds.
    addedBy?: string
  }  // Queue item. `queueItemId` and `addedBy` are assigned by the server.
}
```

### Chat

Available to all connected users.

#### `SendMessage` — Sends a chat message (max 500 characters). The payload is either a string or an object with `content` and an optional `replyToId`.

```ts
{
  type: "SendMessage"
  payload: (string | {
    content: string
    replyToId: string
  })
}
```

Example:

```json
{"type": "SendMessage", "payload": {"content": "this song slaps", "replyToId": null}}
```

### Manage the room

Restricted to the host.

#### `KickUser` — Removes a user from the room.

```ts
{
  type: "KickUser"
  payload: string  // Target user ID.
}
```

#### `CloseRoom` — Closes the room and disconnects all users.

```ts
{
  type: "CloseRoom"
}
```

## Server → client (receive)

### Room updates

Messages pushed by the server.

#### `Pong` — Keepalive response.

```ts
{
  type: "Pong"
}
```

#### `RoomState` — Full room snapshot, sent once immediately after connecting.

```ts
{
  type: "RoomState"
  payload: {
    room: object  // Same structure as the items returned by `GET /rooms/public`.
    queue: {
      queueItemId?: string
      songId: string
      title?: string
      artists?: string
      audioUrl?: string
      hlsUrl?: string
      coverUrl?: string
      duration?: number  // Duration in seconds.
      addedBy?: string
    }[]  // each item: Queue item. `queueItemId` and `addedBy` are assigned by the server.
    listeners: {
      userId: string
      displayName: string
      avatarUrl: string
      frameTheme: int
      level: int
      isHost: bool
      isCoHost: bool
    }[]
    nowPlaying: {
      queueItemId: string
      songId: string
      title: string
      artists: string
      audioUrl: string
      hlsUrl: string
      coverUrl: string
      positionSeconds: number
      durationSeconds: number
      isPlaying: bool
      serverTimestampMs: int  // Server time (Unix ms) when the snapshot was taken. Add the elapsed time to `positionSeconds` to get the current position.
    }
    repeatMode: string  // Possible values: `Off`, `All`, `One`
  }
}
```

#### `PlaybackSync` — Current song and playback position. Sent after every playback change and periodically during playback.

```ts
{
  type: "PlaybackSync"
  payload: {
    queueItemId: string
    songId: string
    title: string
    artists: string
    audioUrl: string
    hlsUrl: string
    coverUrl: string
    positionSeconds: number
    durationSeconds: number
    isPlaying: bool
    serverTimestampMs: int  // Server time (Unix ms) when the snapshot was taken. Add the elapsed time to `positionSeconds` to get the current position.
  }
}
```

#### `QueueUpdated` — Full queue, sent on every change. Replaces the client's copy.

```ts
{
  type: "QueueUpdated"
  payload: {
    queueItemId?: string
    songId: string
    title?: string
    artists?: string
    audioUrl?: string
    hlsUrl?: string
    coverUrl?: string
    duration?: number  // Duration in seconds.
    addedBy?: string
  }[]  // each item: Queue item. `queueItemId` and `addedBy` are assigned by the server.
}
```

#### `RepeatModeChanged` — Repeat mode changed.

```ts
{
  type: "RepeatModeChanged"
  payload: string  // Possible values: `Off`, `All`, `One`
}
```

#### `ListenerJoined` — A user joined the room.

```ts
{
  type: "ListenerJoined"
  payload: {
    userId: string
    displayName: string
    avatarUrl: string
    frameTheme: int
    level: int
    isHost: bool
    isCoHost: bool
  }
}
```

#### `ListenerLeft` — A user left the room.

```ts
{
  type: "ListenerLeft"
  payload: string  // Target user ID.
}
```

#### `ListenerCount` — Current number of connections in the room.

```ts
{
  type: "ListenerCount"
  payload: int
}
```

#### `CoHostsUpdated` — Co-host list changed.

```ts
{
  type: "CoHostsUpdated"
  payload: string[]  // User IDs of the current co-hosts.
}
```

#### `RoomSettingsUpdated` — Room settings changed (name, visibility, listener permissions).

```ts
{
  type: "RoomSettingsUpdated"
  payload: object
}
```

#### `ReceiveMessage` — New chat message.

```ts
{
  type: "ReceiveMessage"
  payload: {
    id: string
    userId: string
    displayName: string
    avatarUrl: string
    content: string
    timestamp: date-time
    replyToId: string
    isBot: bool
  }
}
```

#### `ReceiveMessageHistory` — Recent chat history, sent on connect.

```ts
{
  type: "ReceiveMessageHistory"
  payload: {
    id: string
    userId: string
    displayName: string
    avatarUrl: string
    content: string
    timestamp: date-time
    replyToId: string
    isBot: bool
  }[]
}
```

#### `MessageDeleted` — A chat message was deleted.

```ts
{
  type: "MessageDeleted"
  payload: string  // Message ID.
}
```

#### `SongSuggestion` — Song results from the room bot in response to chat commands such as search or recommend.

```ts
{
  type: "SongSuggestion"
  payload: object
}
```

#### `Kicked` — Sent to a user who was removed. The connection closes immediately afterwards.

```ts
{
  type: "Kicked"
  payload: string  // Reason for removal.
}
```

#### `RoomClosed` — The room was closed. All connections are terminated.

```ts
{
  type: "RoomClosed"
}
```

#### `Error` — The previous client message was rejected.

```ts
{
  type: "Error"
  payload: string
}
```
